description: Progressive harness challenges (easy to hard) for jarvis dev. Natural prompts, NO tool hints (protocol 14: never teach the solution). World-state verified independently. Tiers easy/medium/hard stay in ENGLISH (comparability across models; the local model yields more). Tier 'ptbr' is a DELIBERATE deficiency probe (2026-09-24: bonsai/ternary handles PT-BR poorly and PT-BR is the owner's real language) — it is NOT part of the E/M/H ladder and its score must be reported separately.
